data.name: DialogTrackAllMinimized
data.value: Record minimized windows from all programs

data.name: HelpHotkey
data.value: Global hotkey that minimizes the current foreground window. The key name is the last part, for example Win+Q.

data.name: HelpMoveHotkey
data.value: Minimizes the current window, then moves its restore position to the other configured screen.

data.name: HelpRestoreHotkey
data.value: Restores the most recently minimized window. With all-window history enabled, this includes windows minimized by other programs.

data.name: HelpMode
data.value: Minimize sends the window to the taskbar. Hide removes it from the screen and the taskbar; use the hidden-windows menu to bring it back.

data.name: HelpLanguage
data.value: Auto follows the Windows display language. English and Chinese force the interface language.

data.name: HelpMonitors
data.value: The two screens used by the screen-switch hotkey. A window on screen A moves to B, a window on B moves to A, and a window on another screen moves to B.

data.name: HelpRestoreAnimation
data.value: Native keeps the Windows restore animation. Fade and Disable avoid a cross-screen animation; System default leaves the animation untouched.

data.name: HelpTrackAll
data.value: Record windows minimized by any program, not only by this tool. Win+W then restores from that larger history.

data.name: HelpUpdates
data.value: Check GitHub releases at startup. Auto update downloads and installs a newer full or lite build after checking its SHA-256 checksum when available.

data.name: HelpStartup
data.value: Start WindowMinimize when you sign in. The elevated option uses a highest-run-level scheduled task.

data.name: HelpLog
data.value: Write diagnostic messages to hotkey.log next to the executable.

data.name: HelpNotifications
data.value: Choose which tray balloons are shown: startup, errors, and permission or elevation notices.

data.name: Usage
data.value:
WindowMinimize - minimize the current window with a hotkey
usage: WindowMinimize.exe [options]
options: --hotkey <combination> the minimize hotkey to use, for example --hotkey Win+Q syntax: a modifier (Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win) plus one main key (A-Z, 0-9, F1-F24, Space, Esc, Enter and so on) joined with +; without a modifier only function keys are allowed --mode <mode> minimize (default, to the taskbar) or hide (hide the window) --config <path> use this config file, defaults to hotkey.ini next to the exe --lang <language> interface language, en or zh, defaults to the system language --debug write a debug log to hotkey.log next to the exe --no-tray do not show the tray icon --help show this help
hotkey.ini example: [general] Hotkey=Win+S Mode=minimize AutoStart=true Debug=false
notes: Started by double click the tool stays in the tray and the hotkey minimizes whatever window is in front. The tray menu minimizes once, suspends the hotkey, opens the config, toggles the auto start and exits. Saving hotkey.ini takes effect right away.
